visual.title: Read all four parameters from one equation
visual.caption: In y = 2 sin(3(x + π/4)) − 1 the amplitude is 2, the period is 2π/3, the phase shift is π/4 to the left and the midline is y = −1.

predict.question: For y = 2 sin(3(x + π/4)) − 1, what is the phase shift?
predict.explain: The inside is 3(x + π/4), which is 3(x − (−π/4)). The phase shift is C = −π/4, so the graph moves π/4 to the left; the 3 changes the period, not the size of the shift.
